description:
"A Life-or-Death Escape Room Game!"    
Hyunchul, fired from his job and drunk out of his mind, is wandering the streets when someone hands him a flyer. The flyer promises a prize of 100 million won to anyone who successfully escapes from the game…

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/8250), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12202153), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5700000016), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000069282), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250234), Metoon

**Official Translations:**  
English ([Toomics](https://toomics.com/en/webtoon/episode/toon/8250), HoneyToon), [Japanese](https://toomics.com/ja/webtoon/episode/toon/8250), [B.Portuguese](https://toomics.com/por/webtoon/episode/toon/8250)
